facts.text: I am trying to work on a project that involves data analysis.
I participated in a webinar titled "Data Analysis using Python" two months ago.
The webinar was organized by an online learning platform.
I was hoping to dive deeper into data visualization resources shared in the webinar.
I am considering whether to start with Matplotlib or Seaborn for creating statistical graphics.
I think I will start with Seaborn.
I want tips on how to effectively communicate insights from data visualization to non-technical stakeholders.
I am thinking of creating a dashboard to track key metrics for my project.
I am considering whether Tableau or Power BI would be a good choice for the dashboard.
I am thinking of using Python to connect to the data source.
I do not think the data connection and integration aspect is a major concern for me.
I am more interested in the ease of use and customization options of the dashboard itself.
I think I will try out both Tableau and Power BI's free trials.
I will explore Tableau and Power BI's Python APIs and documentation.
I want to see which dashboard tool feels more comfortable for me.

events.text: Participated in webinar titled "Data Analysis using Python"
